title: Corpus Evidence
text:
Corpus research has transformed how teachers understand collocations. By examining millions of words of real writing, researchers can measure which combinations appear far more often than chance would predict. Such evidence has revealed that some pairs, such as strong tea and powerful car, are preferred over others that might seem equally logical. Learners who rely on intuition alone may therefore choose combinations that are grammatical but rare.

Dictionaries now include frequency information partly for this reason. A learner who checks a phrase before using it can avoid many small errors. However, corpus data show patterns rather than rules, and a frequent combination is not always the most appropriate one for a particular register. Good writers combine the evidence with their own judgement about the audience and purpose of the text.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what can corpus research measure?
options: Which combinations appear far more often than chance would predict
The exact pronunciation of every word
The number of grammar exercises in a book

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do dictionaries now include?
What can be inferred about learners who rely on intuition alone?
options: They always choose the most common phrases
They may produce grammatical but rare combinations

questions.text: What does the writer suggest about frequent combinations?
options: They are always the best choice for every text
They must be avoided by good writers
They are not always appropriate for a particular register
They are found only in novels

vocabulary.definition: how often something happens or appears
a feeling of knowing something without conscious reasoning
suitable for a particular situation or purpose

paragraph_translations: لقد غيّر بحث المدوّنات اللغوية الطريقة التي يفهم بها المعلمون التوافقات اللفظية. فمن خلال فحص ملايين الكلمات من كتابات حقيقية، يستطيع الباحثون قياس الأزواج التي تظهر بتكرار أكبر بكثير مما يتوقعه الصدفة. وقد كشفت هذه الأدلة أن بعض الأزواج، مثل strong tea وpowerful car، مفضلة على أزواج أخرى قد تبدو منطقية بالقدر نفسه. لذلك قد يختار المتعلمون الذين يعتمدون على الحدس وحده توافقات صحيحة نحوياً لكنها نادرة.

تحتوي القواميس اليوم على معلومات عن التكرار جزئياً لهذا السبب. فالمتعلم الذي يتحقق من عبارة قبل استعمالها يستطيع تجنب كثير من الأخطاء الصغيرة. غير أن بيانات المدوّنات تُظهر أنماطاً لا قواعد، والتوافق المتكرر ليس دائماً الأنسب لسجلّ لغوي بعينه. ويجمع الكتّاب الجيدون الأدلة مع حكمهم الخاص على الجمهور والغرض من النص.
